description: Proof that oferoo.eu recorded a price on a day and did not change it since: for each price of the product in the country, the exact line of the published daily file, its Merkle path to the root of the day, the timestamp and the Sui / Base transactions of that root. Verify it yourself with the steps at /dovezi/<day>. Costs 1 credit (0.002 USDC with x402).

country.description: ISO-2 country code in lower case (al, at, ba, be, bg, ch, cy, cz, de, dk, ee, es, fi, fr, gb, gr, hr, hu, ie, is, it, lt, lu, lv, mt, nl, pl, pt, ro, rs, se, si, sk, tr)

name: proof
title: Merkle proof of a price
